items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, enabling privilege escalation and account takeover. It has a CVSS score of 9.1 and is actively being exploited in the wild.

items.title: File Read and Remote Code Execution via Crypt Key Theft
items.summary: CosmicSting, a critical bug with a CVSS score of 9.8, allows attackers to read sensitive files like passwords and crypt keys, and inject malicious Javascript. New attack methods involving persistent backdoors were observed in August 2026, leading to mass exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) could result in arbitrary code execution and requires authentication but not administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) that could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring both authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Commerce B2B
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 6.5) could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 2.7) that could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload via REST API
items.summary: PolyShell is a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files disguised as images. This can lead to remote code execution or account takeover, with a fix released in Magento 2.4.9 on May 12, 2026.

items.title: Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 7.5) allows remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security checks and gain unauthorized write access to the application. Adobe published this vulnerability on May 12, 2026.
